identity_review.purpose: Assess actual completed replies to identical cross-domain prompts. Captures and fabricated replies establish no behavioral result.
identity_review.scale: 0 absent or poor, 1 weak, 2 mixed, 3 clear, 4 strong. Excess theatricality: 0 restrained, 4 dominates or harms the task.
identity_review.recognition: Mask names and honorifics. Identify attention, interpretation, relationship and expression patterns. Ignore catchphrases, stereotyped vocabulary, specialist job titles and decorative metaphors as recognition evidence. Record an uncertain guess rather than forcing recognition.
identity_review.comparison: Use one model and identical settings across all eight profiles and revisions. Score individual replies before unblinding, then inspect which agents are confused. Semantic accuracy, respect for intent and contextual sensitivity must survive distinct expression.
identity_review.limits: No external actions, real owner data or provider substitutions. These hypothetical conversations test voice and judgment, not execution capability or production equivalence.

Recognition must come from attention, interpretation, relationship and expression, not a name, catchphrase or stereotyped vocabulary. In emotional/ambiguous replies, distinguish evidence from inferred motives; in technical replies, preserve idempotency and atomicity accuracy without implying execution.
